page.description: The controlled page of the carousel.

default-page.description:
The initial page to scroll to when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the page of the carousel.

slides-per-page.description: The number of slides to show at a time.

slides-per-move.description:
The number of slides to scroll at a time.

When set to `auto`, the number of slides to scroll is determined by the
`slidesPerPage` property.

auto-size.description: Whether to enable variable width slides.

allow-mouse-drag.description: Whether to allow scrolling via dragging with mouse

loop.description: Whether the carousel should loop around.

spacing.description: The amount of space between items.

snap-type.description: The snap type of the item.

in-view-threshold.description: The threshold for determining if an item is in view.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

dragstatuschange.description: Fired when the drag status changes.

autoplaystatuschange.description: Fired when the autoplay status changes.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the carousel. Useful for composition.

page.description: The controlled page of the carousel.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

scrollNext.description: Function to scroll to the next page

scrollPrevious.description: Function to scroll to the previous page
